title: Role Acceleration Blueprint - 21-Day Skill Ramp
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, playbook-style blueprint for accelerating new hires (IC and IC+PM pairs) through the first 21 days. Goal is actionable tasks for managers, mentors, and new hires that produce 3 measurable outcomes: (1) base-level product/domain fluency, (2) first cross-team PR or customer-facing artifact, (3) clarity on next-90-day growth objectives.

Audience:
People Ops, hiring managers, hiring mentors, solution/tech leads who will run a condensed skill-acceleration sprint. Designed for multi-function roles but tuned toward engineering/product hires joining infra, runtime, and console teams.

High-level constraints / assumptions (notes to self):
- Not a replacement for 90-day plan; this is a front-loaded ramp to create meaningful early velocity.
- Requires a committed mentor (0.25 FTE for 21 days) and a buddy for day-to-day questions.
- Keep async-first whenever possible; schedule no more than 50% meeting load.
- Localize role tasks to team backlog: pick 1 low-risk but end-to-end ticket that results in a PR or doc.

Core outcomes (what success looks like at day 21):
- Product fluency: can explain the serving runtime top-to-bottom at a 5-minute level; identify 2 dependency owners to escalate to.
- Deliverable: merged PR or published how-to doc that touches infra + CI + runbook, or a small customer demo script used by solutions engineering.
- Personal growth: candidate and manager agree on 3 clear stretch goals for next 90 days with measurable signals.

21-day micro-plan (week-by-week tasks and checkpoints):
- Days 0-3 (land and orient):
  - Preboarding checklist must be complete before day 0 (account access, laptop, VPN, Slack, internal docs).
  - 45-min welcome w/ manager: role expectations, team mission narrative, top three priorities.
  - Mentor 1:1 kickoff (30 min): "skill passport" review (candidate self-assessment of strengths/weaknesses).
  - Assign first small repo/infra read + local dev inner-loop doc.
  - Deliverable: run local dev flow and open a tiny PR (documentation or test) by day 3.

- Days 4-10 (deep context + shadowing):
  - Daily 30-min pairing sessions with mentor (alternating pairing/async).
  - Domain immersion: 2 curated demos (serving runtime path, deployment flow) with short note-taking template.
  - Cross-team synchs: intro to observability and SRE owner.
  - Hands-on task: triage or reproduce a non-critical bug and propose a fix.
  - Checkpoint: manager quick sync at day 8 to confirm trajectory.

- Days 11-17 (deliver and iterate):
  - Focused execution block: work on end-to-end ticket. Mentor triage at least twice.
  - Feature/regression test authored and run on CI (or documented manual test plan).
  - Conduct a short walkthrough of work with solutions engineering or product partner.
  - Checkpoint: public demo to team + short retrospective notes.

- Days 18-21 (handoff and future plan):
  - Finalize PR/doc and get merged/published.
  - Manager + hire 30-min alignment: set 90-day goals and measurable signals.
  - Mentor writes a short "handoff note" with remaining risks and recommended next tasks.
  - Celebration: 15-min team share + quick feedback pulse (one-question survey).

Roles and responsibilities (concise):
- Manager: priority-setting, remove blockers, 1x 45-min kickoff + weekly checkins.
- Mentor: daily pairing/async review, guide the end-to-end ticket, create 2 targeted learning artifacts.
- Buddy: ad-hoc help with access, calendar, tooling.
- New hire: owns at least one concrete deliverable and the skill passport truthfully.

Interview calibration & quick rubric for mentors (mini):
- Technical depth (0-4): understands core system/components, can explain tradeoffs.
- Practicality (0-4): suggests feasible small fixes or tests, writes clear reproducer.
- Communication (0-3): can craft a short runbook bullet and demo script.
- Autonomy signal (0-3): how much hand-holding required after week 2.
Notes: this is used by mentor at day 10 and day 21. Keep scores short and share with manager.

Checklists (copyable):
- Preboarding: laptop encrypted, accounts created (GH, Jira, Confluence, PagerDuty), VPN, internal DNS, calendar invites for first 2 weeks.
- Day-1: welcome doc read, team org chart, basic infra diagram, primary contact list.
- Week-1 deliverable: local dev success + tiny PR.
- Week-3 deliverable: merged PR or published how-to + demo.

Artifacts to produce (minimum):
- "Skill passport" one-pager (template included below).
- One merged PR or published doc.
- Mentor handoff note.

Skill passport (one-pager template, paste into candidate doc):
- Role: (team + short sentence)
- Self-rated skills (1-5): codebase familiarity, infra ops, observability, CI, customer comms.
- 3 prior wins relevant to role.
- 3 immediate learning goals for 21 days.
- Preferred mentoring cadence.

Open questions / decisions to make (notes for POPS):
- Should we formalize a compensation for mentors? current assumption is ad-hoc. Recommend a 0.25 FTE reserve for critical early hires.
- Which teams want a "21-day acceleration" vs. the standard 90-day onboarding? propose pilot with infra + console teams.
- Instrumentation: add a short day-21 survey to measure confidence and mentor feedback.

Quick references and links (for manager/mentor):
- Onboarding assets: Confluence onboarding home (linked in metadata).
- Internal demo repo: github.com/redwood-inference/internal-onboarding (PR in linked_artifacts).
- Calendar templates: copy "21-day pairing" events into new hire invite.

Draft action items (next steps):
- People Ops to run two pilot hires with this blueprint in March (assign mentors and set up calendar templates).
- Engineering managers to nominate one low-risk end-to-end ticket per hire by Feb 28.
- Follow-up: collect day-21 pulse and iterate blueprint.

Inline notes to self (tone: informal):
- Keep docs short; managers overloaded. Include copy-paste checklists.
- Emphasize early wins to improve retention and momentum.
- Iterate after 4 pilots and share results in weekly people ops sync.

Version history (basic):
- 2025-02-03: initial draft (Avery).
- 2025-02-15: added mentor rubric and checklists (Marisol).
- 2025-02-20: refined deliverables, added linked artifacts (Daniel).

End.
